counseling.title: Talk it through with a genetic counselor
counseling.body: A counselor can explain your results and answer your questions, at your pace.

ivf_pgtm.title: IVF with PGT-M
ivf_pgtm.body: Available under Thiqa. PGT-M needs the written consent of both spouses. After PGT-M, confirmatory prenatal testing is still recommended.

prenatal_diagnosis.title: Prenatal diagnosis
prenatal_diagnosis.body: A specialist and a genetic counselor can explain what this involves.

own_choice.title: Your own choices about marriage and family
own_choice.body: Every option here is yours to consider or not. There is no right or wrong choice.

family_screening.title: Offer screening to relatives
family_screening.body: You can create a private family screening token that does not identify you.

immediate.met: No waiting period applies because of your screening result.
immediate.not_met: A counselor can explain the usual waiting period.

age.met: Your age is within the usual range.
age.needs_afc: An ovarian reserve test is needed before this can be confirmed.
age.discouraged: Treatment at this age is usually discouraged; a specialist can explain why.
age.female_partner_only: This check applies to the female partner.

bmi.met: Your BMI is within the usual range.
bmi.dietitian_referral: Covered under Thiqa, together with a referral to a dietitian.
bmi.needs_review: A specialist will review this with you.
bmi.female_partner_only: This check applies to the female partner.

cryo.first_year: Cryopreservation in the first year is noted for your care team.

pgtm.prenatal_confirmation: PGT-M needs the written consent of both spouses. After PGT-M, confirmatory prenatal testing is recommended.

next.invite: Invite your partner to a private compatibility check
next.consent: Your partner invited you. Review and give consent
next.counseling: Book a conversation with a genetic counselor

notif.counselor_contact: A genetic counselor will contact you
notif.consent_received: Your partner invited you to a compatibility check
notif.consent_revoked: A consent was withdrawn and shared results were removed
notif.task_created: A new step was added to your care plan
notif.shared_gene: Your partner shared one result with you

loop.PatientNotified: You were notified of your result
loop.HumanClosure: Your counselor closed this care episode

q.carrier_not_diagnosis: Being a carrier means I have the disease.
q.each_pregnancy: When both partners carry a change in the same gene, the chance applies to every pregnancy separately.
q.negative_not_zero: A negative screening result can still leave a small chance of being a carrier.
q.you_decide: Decisions about marriage and family are mine to make.
